title: BTE France Modpack
description: This is the official BTE France Modpack, making building easier !
body:
![Build The Earth France Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/93858a531606ae7b454f5adc77a9da06a77a0323.png)

A useful building modpack created to optimize and facilitate construction on a 1:1 scale

![Horizontal line](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/892982f0c371e6dfd3b38ac47457362b384a3ade_0.webp)
### Features
- 🗺️ Mapping Tools - explore and navigate France with Xaero's Minimap & World Map - 🏗️ Building Utilities - build faster and more precisely using WorldEdit & AxiomTool - 🔎 Laz Viewer - visualize BTE data directly in-game with Laz Viewer for BTE - 🪧 Sign Writing - create realistic French road signs with Big Sign Writer - 🎮 Command Shortcuts - improve workflow with customizable Command Keys - 🔭 Zoom - inspect distant builds using Logical Zoom - ✨ Shaders Included - immersive visuals with Complementary Unbound & Solas Shader - ⚡ Performance - optimized gameplay thanks to Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore & Entity Culling - 🧩 Mod Management - easy configuration with Mod Menu ![Horizontal line](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/892982f0c371e6dfd3b38ac47457362b384a3ade_0.webp)
### ❓ FAQ ❓
--- **Q: Do I need a powerful PC to run the modpack?** **A:** Not at all ! The modpack includes several optimization mods such as Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore and Entity Culling to improve FPS and reduce memory usage. For the best experience, shaders remain optional. --- **Q: Can I use this modpack outside of BTE France?** **A:** Absolutely. The modpack also works great for creative servers, city projects, infrastructure builds and realistic map creation. Please note that Laz Viewer will not work properly outside of BTE France, as it was specifically developed for our world projection system. However, all other mods can still be used normally. --- **Q: Is this modpack mandatory for BTE France?** **A:** While not always strictly required, this modpack is highly recommended for all BTE France builders to ensure compatibility, consistent tools and easier collaboration. --- ![Horizontal line](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/892982f0c371e6dfd3b38ac47457362b384a3ade_0.webp) Please feel free to ask any questions on our discord server : [https://discord.gg/QNBHn6gNb3](url)
